f7c0ef.title: Build-secret leakage audit: invariant HOLDS (CONTENT_API_KEY/GHOST_URL never in client artifacts)
f7c0ef.content: # Build-Secret Leakage Audit — portfolio-astro (agent dc9d914f) **Verdict: the critical invariant HOLDS. No leak of CONTENT_API_KEY or any credential in any client-visible artifact. Nothing filed — no vulnerability exists.** ## Check-by-check closure (all on fresh `bun run build`, 19 pages, 65 dist files) 1. **dist/ value grep — ruled out.** `grep -RIlF` with the real `.env` values (never printed): CONTENT_API_KEY = 0 matches in dist/ (both old and fresh build). GHOST_URL value (`https://blogs.aplix.nl`) matched 12 blog HTML files, but every occurrence is CMS-authored post content: `` and `` — inherent public image/hosting references with **no `?key=` and no credential material**; browsers must fetch those images from that host by design. `src/` never references GHOST_URL in link construction (rg: only astro.config.mjs + src/lib/ghost.ts). No `CONTENT_API_KEY|GHOST_URL` identifiers in any dist file. 2. **dist/.prerender / non-public files — ruled out.** Fully-static build emits NO `dist/.prerender` (verified: absent before and after rebuild; exhaustive `find` shows only the 65 public files, no dotfiles, no .env). Dockerfile `RUN rm -rf /app/dist/.prerender` is correctly scoped defense-in-depth and the runtime stage copies only `/app/dist`; nginx `try_files` can only serve what exists; live `/.prerender/` = 404. (Could not observe .prerender contents because no server build exists — moot: no server output is produced or shipped.) 3. **Source maps — ruled out.** No `*.map` in dist, no `sourceMappingURL` in any dist asset, live `.js.map` = 404. 4. **Fresh rebuild — clean.** Installed bun 1.4.3; `bun install --frozen-lockfile` (no changes); `bun run build` succeeded against real Ghost API. All checks re-run on fresh output with identical results. `.env` is not in `public/` and never copied to dist. 5. **Git history — ruled out.** `.env` never tracked (`git ls-files`); `git log --all -S""` → zero commits; gitleaks 8.30.1 over 32 commits → 0 leaks; trufflehog fs (working tree excl. .git/node_modules/dist) → 0 findings. GHOST_URL value appears in history (commit 8ac4e14, `.ai-memory` docs) — public hostname, not a credential. 6. **Docker build context — hardening gap (no vuln).** `.dockerignore` excludes `.env`, `.env.*`, `.git`, `dist`, `node_modules` ✓. NOT excluded: `strix_runs/`, `.ai-memory/`, `.agents/`, `.claude/`, `.pi/`, `.vscode/`, `opencode.json`, `skills-lock.json` — these get `COPY . .`'d into **build-stage layers only**. Verified: CONTENT_API_KEY exists nowhere outside `.env`; those dirs contain only the public GHOST_URL + prior scan artifacts. Final image (nginx:alpine) receives only `/app/dist`, so nothing sensitive ships. Docker unavailable in sandbox — static analysis. **Recommendation (not a finding):** add `strix_runs`, `.ai-memory`, `.agents`, `.claude`, `.pi`, `.vscode`, `opencode.json`, `skills-lock.json` to .dockerignore; prefer BuildKit `--secret` mounts over `--build-arg` so the key never sits in build-stage ENV/history (build stage is not pushed today, so risk is latent). 7. **Sitemap — ruled out.** `sitemap-0.xml` = 18 URLs, all `https://portfolio.aplix.nl/...` public pages; no query params, no Ghost host, no internal URLs. robots.txt only points at the sitemap. 8. **Client-side env surface — ruled out.** Only `astro:env/server` import exists (`src/lib/ghost.ts:2`); no `astro:env/client`, no `import.meta.env`, no `PUBLIC_` vars (the only two env vars are both server-secret); island `props="{}"` (DarkModeToggle, FxToggle); no ClientRouter/ViewTransitions; no env JSON in page HTML. ## Live spot-checks (end-to-end, status codes only) `/.env` → 404 · `/.prerender/` → 404 · `/_astro/*.js.map` → 404 · live blog HTML: key absent. ## Controls that make this safe (named) - `astro.config.mjs:14-15` — `envField.string({ context: 'server', access: 'secret' })` keeps both values out of client bundles; build fails fast if missing. - `src/lib/ghost.ts:2` — sole consumer, imported by build-time page code only; never referenced from client components. - `Dockerfile` — `.env` never enters build context (.dockerignore); secrets via ARG/ENV in build stage only; `rm -rf /app/dist/.prerender`; runtime stage copies only `dist`. - `.gitignore:21` — `.env` ignored; never committed (verified by history scans). Artifacts: `/workspace/.build-secret-audit/` (gitleaks-history.json = empty, trufflehog-fs.json = empty).

a0c38f.title: Code Map & SAST Baseline — portfolio-astro (wave 1)
a0c38f.content:
# Code Map & SAST Baseline — portfolio-astro

Fully static Astro 7 + Vue-island site, prerendered by `bun run build`, served by nginx. No SSR/API/backend/auth. Artifacts in `/workspace/.artifacts/code-map/`.

## Route / Component Map

All pages wrap `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro` (Header + main slot + Footer + `FxToggle client:load` + inline no-FOUC theme/fx script + `initFx()` + scroll-reveal observer).

- `src/pages/index.astro` → BaseLayout (hero, featured projects, ExternalLink icon)
- `src/pages/projets.astro` → BaseLayout (all projects, `Voir le site` / `Code source` links)
- `src/pages/services.astro` → BaseLayout
- `src/pages/experience.astro` → BaseLayout
- `src/pages/a-propos.astro` → BaseLayout
- `src/pages/contact.astro` → BaseLayout (FormSubmit.co form)
- `src/pages/404.astro` → BaseLayout
- `src/pages/blog/[...slug].astro` → BaseLayout + `lib/ghost.getAllPosts()` — single merged route: listing page 1 (slug=undefined), listing pages 2..N (slug=N), and one path per post (slug=post.slug). `getStaticPaths()` fetches all posts at build.
- `BaseLayout.astro` → `Header.astro` (→ `DarkModeToggle.vue client:load`, mobile-menu script), `FxToggle.vue client:load`, `Footer.astro`, `lib/fx.initFx()`.

**`src/components/ui/**` (vendored shadcn-vue): UNREACHABLE.** Import grep across `src/pages`, `src/layouts`, `src/components/base`, `src/components/interactive` for `from '...ui/...'` returns nothing. No page/layout/base imports any ui component. Deprioritized per scope; only notable sink is `ui/chart/utils.ts:41-42` `innerHTML` (CSS-to-style-tag helper), unreachable.

## Data Flows

- `src/data/portfolio.ts` (site, images, socials, projects, skills, experiences, services, bio, certifications) → consumed by pages + Header/Footer. All values rendered as escaped text or attributes. URLs are static `https://` / `mailto:` / `tel:`; every external link (`target="_blank"`) carries `rel="noopener noreferrer"` (index.astro:147, projets.astro:53+64, contact.astro:102, Footer.astro:28).
- Ghost: `GHOST_URL`/`CONTENT_API_KEY` (astro:env/server) → `src/lib/ghost.ts` (GhostContentAPI v5, `getAllPosts`/`getPosts`, paginated, `visibility:public`) → `blog/[...slug].astro` getStaticPaths → post fields rendered; **only `post.html` is raw-injected via `set:html`**; title/excerpt/tags/feature_image/author render escaped.

## Sink Inventory (file:line)

- **`src/pages/blog/[...slug].astro:223`** — `<Fragment set:html={Astro.props.post.html} />`. RAW HTML sink (CMS→stored XSS). No sanitizer, no CSP anywhere. PRIMARY candidate.
- `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro:58,66` — inline script reads `localStorage.theme` / `localStorage.fx`; strict `===` compares, no DOM injection. Safe.
- `src/lib/fx.ts:235,246,279,282` — `JSON.parse` of localStorage (achievements/visited) in try/catch + `Array.isArray` guard; `showToast` (fx.ts:251-274) uses `textContent`, not innerHTML. Safe.
- `src/components/interactive/FxToggle.vue:10,20` & `DarkModeToggle.vue:9,27` — localStorage read/write, safe.
- `src/pages/contact.astro:17-70` — FormSubmit.co POST (`action` line 18), `_captcha=false` (line 24), `_subject`/`_template` hidden (23,25), honeypot `_honey` (26). Form-abuse candidate.
- `src/components/ui/chart/utils.ts:41-42` — `innerHTML` (unreachable vendored ui).
- `src/components/base/Header.astro:81-90` — mobile-menu toggle, safe.

## Top SAST / Config Signals

- **semgrep (3× WARNING): `docker/nginx.conf:28,33,39`** — `add_header Cache-Control ...` inside `location` blocks for `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap-index.xml`, `/_astro/` **override/drop the server-level security headers** (nginx does not inherit parent `add_header` once a location defines its own). Those paths lose HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. Config candidate.
- **trivy misconfig:** `Dockerfile` DS-0002 runtime image user is root (HIGH), DS-0026 no HEALTHCHECK (LOW).
- **trivy vuln (bun.lock, all transitive BUILD-time deps, not shipped to client):** `devalue@5.9.2` (CVE-2026-92708 + GHSA-mcm9-63f2-9j32, GHSA-r9w8-h9r3-54w4, GHSA-x5rw-q4pp-hg5g — HIGH; direct dep of `astro@7.3.2`); `http-cache-semantics@4.2.0` (CVE-2026-93748 HIGH; direct dep of `astro`); `source-map-js@1.2.1` (CVE-2026-93749 HIGH; transitive via @tailwindcss/node, @vue/compiler-*, postcss, magicast, css-tree). Build-toolchain only.
- **gitleaks:** no leaks. **trufflehog:** 37 unverified hits, ALL inside `node_modules`/`dist`/`strix_runs` (none in source). No source secrets.

## Secret Consumers (GHOST_URL / CONTENT_API_KEY)

Only three files touch these values; **none import them client-side**:
- `astro.config.mjs:14-15` — env schema, `context:'server' access:'secret'` (correct scoping).
- `src/lib/ghost.ts:2,5,6` — `import ... from 'astro:env/server'` → GhostContentAPI.
- `Dockerfile:4-7` — `ARG`/`ENV` at build; `Dockerfile:16` — `rm -rf /app/dist/.prerender` before nginx stage.

`.dockerignore` excludes `.env`/`.env.*`; `.gitignore` excludes `.env`. No static evidence of secret leak; **dist/ client-artifact verification is a dynamic task for wave 2.**

## Prioritized Candidate List (for orchestrator)

1. **XSS / stored HTML injection** — `blog/[...slug].astro:223` `set:html`, no sanitizer, no CSP. Class: XSS. (High if CMS compromised.)
2. **Config exposure — security-header drop** — `docker/nginx.conf:27-41` add_header redefinition in location blocks. Class: config/header. (Medium/Low.)
3. **Form abuse — FormSubmit special-field injection** — `contact.astro:17-70`, `_captcha` disabled. Class: form abuse / CSRF-triggerable mail. (Medium.)
4. **Dependency CVEs (build-time, not client-reachable)** — devalue / http-cache-semantics / source-map-js via astro/tailwind/vue toolchain. Class: dependency CVE. (Low/Info for static site.)
5. **Dockerfile misconfig** — root runtime user (DS-0002), no HEALTHCHECK (DS-0026). Class: config. (Low.)
6. **Secret-leak invariant** — static controls correct; needs dist/ verification (dynamic). Class: secret leak. (Open / verify in wave 2.)

5415a1.title: Live recon: portfolio.aplix.nl deployment fingerprint & path inventory (wave-1)
5415a1.content:
# Live Recon — https://portfolio.aplix.nl (wave-1, discovery only)

## 1. Fingerprint
- **DNS**: `portfolio.aplix.nl` → A `82.29.174.40` (no CNAME, no AAAA). Direct origin; no CDN.
- **TLS**: Let's Encrypt (issuer `CN=YR2`), `CN=portfolio.aplix.nl`, SAN single hostname, valid 2026-09-16 → 2026-12-15. Direct TLS handshake shows **TLSv1.3** (`TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256`); HTTP/2 negotiated on direct connections.
- **Server**: `Server: nginx/1.31.3` on every response. `Alt-Svc: h3=":443"; ma=2592000` advertised (actual HTTP/3 not verified — no h3 client available).
- **WAF/CDN**: wafw00f found none; origin answers directly on 443 with the site's own cert.
- **HTTP→HTTPS**: port 80 returns `308 Permanent Redirect` → `https://portfolio.aplix.nl/`.
- **Build date**: `Last-Modified: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 20:12:48-49 GMT` on static files; Etag + Accept-Ranges present (plain nginx static file serving).
- **Architecture inference**: an outer TLS-terminating layer sits in front of the file-serving nginx. Evidence: (a) port-80 308 redirect is not in repo `docker/nginx.conf`; (b) non-trailing-slash directory requests 301 to **`http://`** absolute URLs (inner nginx builds redirects with `scheme=http`), verified direct without proxy.

## 2. Complete path inventory (status + size)
**200 OK**
- `/` 32699B · `/a-propos/` 17607B · `/experience/` 18053B · `/projets/` 25700B · `/services/` 19653B · `/contact/` 18512B
- `/blog/` 24852B · `/blog/2/` 21416B (pagination)
- 10 blog posts (from `sitemap-0.xml`, all live): `assistants-de-codage-ia-auto-heberges-en-2026-7-alternatives-open-source-a-github-copilot`, `comparatif-2026-keycloak-vs-zitadel-vs-logto-quel-outil-open-source-choisir-pour-lauthentification-de-vos-projets`, `gerer-les-erreurs-dans-une-application-web-moderne-avec-sentry-ou-une-alternative-compatible`, `laravel-13-ia-native-ai-sdk-agents-recherche-vectorielle`, `lidempotence-dans-les-appels-api-eviter-les-doublons-avec-laravel-et-vue-js`, `loco-1-0-rails-de-rust-framework-rust-batteries-included`, `mail-dev-serveur-smtp-local-tauri-rust`, `tauri-vs-electron-match-performances-2026`, `temps-vs-rustrak-deux-alternatives-rust-a-sentry-en-2026`, `vite-8-rolldown-rspack-2-et-vapor-mode-la-grande-bascule-frontend-de-2026`
- `/robots.txt` 78B (Allow: /, points to sitemap-index) · `/sitemap-index.xml` 189B → `/sitemap-0.xml` 2022B (17 URLs) · `/favicon.ico` 655B · `/404.html` 15231B (**publicly fetchable**)

**301 (scheme downgrade — unexpected)**
- `/blog` → `Location: http://portfolio.aplix.nl/blog/` ; `/contact` → `http://portfolio.aplix.nl/contact/` — absolute **http://** redirect from an https site, reproduced direct (no proxy). Likely inner-nginx `$scheme=http` behind the TLS terminator.

**404 (nginx default page, 153B)** — all clean, nothing sensitive served:
`/sitemap.xml`, `/.env`, `/.env.production`, `/.env.local`, `/.env.example`, `/.env.bak`, `/.git/HEAD`, `/.git/config`, `/.gitignore`, `/.dockerignore`, `/Dockerfile`, `/dist/`, `/_prerender/`, `/.prerender/`, `/node_modules/`, `/.npmrc`, `/.DS_Store`, `/backup`, `/backup.zip`, `/config.json`, `/.well-known/`, `/.well-known/security.txt`, `/server-status`, `/.astro/`, `/.htaccess`, `/package.json`, `/bun.lock`, `/astro.config.mjs`, `/.vscode/`, `/sw.js`, `/manifest.json`, `/robots.txt.bak`, `/index.html.bak`

**403**: `/_astro/` (directory listing denied — autoindex off). Directory listing disabled everywhere tested.

**Katana junk artifacts** (not real pages, 404): relative-link concatenations inside blog code blocks, e.g. `/blog/<slug>/Vue.js`, `/blog/<slug>/routes/api.php`, `/blog/<slug>/app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php`.

**External references found in built HTML**: `blogs.aplix.nl` (Ghost CMS origin — post links/feature images point back to it; GHOST_URL disclosure candidate for wave-2), `kwiktalk.aplix.nl`, `github.com/STIFLEUR390`, `github.com/gotempsh/temps`.

**Contact form** (`/contact/`): `<form action="https://formsubmit.co/heroldtamko39@gmail.com" method="POST">`; fields include `_captcha`, `_honey`, `_subject`, `_template`, `name`, `email`, `message`. FormSubmit recipient email is public in page source.

## 3. Header matrix (identical across HTML, sitemap, robots, JS assets, 404s)
**Present**: `Server: nginx/1.31.3`, `Alt-Svc: h3=":443"`, `Content-Type` (text/html · text/plain · application/javascript · application/xml), `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `Etag`, `Last-Modified` (files only).
**Absent on EVERY response**: `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `Content-Security-Policy`, `X-XSS-Protection`, `Cache-Control`. No `Set-Cookie` anywhere (no cookies/sessions — confirms threat model).

## 4. Deployment drift vs repo (IMPORTANT for wave-2)
Repo `docker/nginx.conf` specifies: 5 security headers with `always`, `Cache-Control` for robots/sitemap/`_astro/`, `error_page 404 /404.html` with `location = /404.html { internal; }`.
**Live behaves as if that config is NOT deployed**: no security headers, no Cache-Control, 404s are nginx's default page (not Astro's 404 — page title is `404 Not Found`, 153B), and `/404.html` is publicly reachable (repo marks it internal). Likely an older image or different nginx config in the running container.

## 5. Source maps / client artifacts
- No `sourceMappingURL` in the 3 live JS bundles; direct `.map` probes (`DarkModeToggle.CpSsgo53.js.map`, `client.DJ10rcjL.js.map`) → 404.
- Live hashed assets (`DarkModeToggle.CpSsgo53.js`, `client.DJ10rcjL.js`, `runtime-core.esm-bundler.DgzaXB7b.js`) **do not match** local `dist/_astro` hashes (`Bg_kcKbt`, `DLSIj14G`, `CWYgrEQw`) — local checkout's dist is a stale/different build than the Sep-18 deployed one. Wave-2 must not assume local dist == deployed artifacts.

## 6. Transient anomaly (NOT a control)
Initial sweep returned `502` with ~11B body (each at ~10s curl max-time) for dotfile paths (`/.env*`, `/.git*`); immediately re-tested direct and consistently `404 153B`. Transient front-proxy connectivity hiccup, not a WAF/deny rule — do not treat as protection.

## Handoff candidates for wave-2 (URL + anomaly only, no judgment)
1. **All security headers missing live** despite repo config — every response, e.g. `GET https://portfolio.aplix.nl/` (see matrix above).
2. **nginx default 404** instead of Astro 404 (`/thispagedoesnotexist-xyz123` → 153B); `/404.html` public at 15231B.
3. **Scheme-downgrade 301**: `GET /blog` → `Location: http://portfolio.aplix.nl/blog/` (also `/contact`, presumably any non-slash dir path).
4. **`blogs.aplix.nl` origin disclosed** throughout built blog HTML (Ghost origin leak; wave-2 should also sweep dist artifacts for `CONTENT_API_KEY` — not found in HTML/JS during this recon, but not exhaustively scanned).
5. **FormSubmit endpoint** `https://formsubmit.co/heroldtamko39@gmail.com` with `_subject`/`_template`/`_next`-style special fields present in the form.
6. No `Cache-Control` on immutable hashed `/_astro/*` assets (minor config drift).

59e050.title: GHSA-only advisory backlog in bun.lock (no CVE IDs — not filed as reports)
59e050.content:
Dependency CVE scan (trivy DB 2026-10-14) found 7 GHSA-only advisories in the portfolio-astro bun.lock tree that cannot be filed via create_dependency_report (no CVE mapping in the advisory references):

- devalue 5.9.2 (all fixed by 5.9.3, via astro@7.3.2, pin bun.lock:778):
  - GHSA-mcm9-63f2-9j32 (HIGH) parse→uneval quadratic expansion
  - GHSA-r9w8-h9r3-54w4 (HIGH) malformed ArrayBuffer reviver → massive allocations in parse
  - GHSA-x5rw-q4pp-hg5g (HIGH) stringifyAsync unhandled rejection (upstream: "essentially impossible to exploit")
  - GHSA-4q55-j62x-fr9h (MEDIUM) __proto__ own-property creation in parse
  - GHSA-hx4r-w6wj-j8fg (MEDIUM) uneval sparse-array CPU amplification
  - GHSA-wf3x-273g-mvxv (LOW) uneval sparse-array eager allocation on eval
- smol-toml 1.8.0: GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2 (MEDIUM, CVSS 5.3) quadratic parseKey on dot-free keys; fixed 1.9.0; via @astrojs/internal-helpers@0.11.0 and astro@7.3.2 (bun.lock:1142). Parses TOML config files only — developer-controlled input, build-time only.

All are covered remediation-wise by the lockfile refreshes in filed reports vuln-0001..vuln-0004 (`bun update devalue` → 5.9.3 covers all six devalue GHSAs; smol-toml needs `bun update smol-toml` → 1.9.0, range ^1.6.0 accepts it). No attacker-reachable path found for any of them in this static-site codebase (same usage analysis as devalue/astro findings).
